summary: 6:45 AM ET run, published at 7:19 ET. Nothing to settle, nothing to close; every pick from Sunday was graded overnight. One game on the board, Giants at Rams tonight, and its game lines carry no lean: the spread is a coin flip after calibration and the total is 1.2 points the wrong way. Three prop leans, all at DraftKings: Terrance Ferguson UNDER 32.5 receiving yards -110; Theo Johnson OVER 8.5 receiving yards -111; Devin Singletary OVER 15.5 rushing yards -116. No college until Thursday.
takeaways: Jaxson Dart under 34.5 completions showed a 99.5% read this morning and was not published: DraftKings' completions line came through above his own 31.5 attempts line, which the game cannot produce. The parser now takes the rung below the attempts line as the number, or drops the market, and the research rule says to check a line against the player's other markets before believing it. A number the model loves that the book cannot have meant is a data error every time.

Two lines were also passed for price rather than for the read: Terrance Ferguson under 2.5 receptions at -151 and Davante Adams under 5.5 at -158. The prop rule now caps a lean at -200 and at one per player, so the same player's yards and receptions cannot both ride.
